title: Add Rock Band conversion to Browser
description: Add Rock Band conversion to the browser tool (Future item, migrated from TODO.md).

title: Tweak Rock Band conversion logic to support multiple difficulties
description: Rock Band conversion tweak: in RockBandConverter.cs, stop discarding Easy/Medium/Hard octave-tier notes at the difficulty == Expert gate — instead keep Expert as the default Notes and push each lower tier into notes.AlternateLevels as a SongDifficultyLevel (ordinal Difficulty 0/1/2, StartTime/EndTime spanning the whole song). This mirrors PsarcConverter.cs's existing hardest-tier-default/lower-tiers-as-alternates pattern, just without phrase-scoping since Rock Band's tiers cover the full song rather than individual phrases.

title: Piano notation output support
description: Add piano notation output support to SongConverter (v0.1.2 item, migrated from TODO.md).

title: Type-check psarc song.json against SongInfo
description: Validate the .psarc path's song.json builder against the SongInfo type (v0.1.2 item, migrated from TODO.md). That builder has no SongInfo annotation, so required fields like GeneratedBy are unchecked there.

title: MusicXML Phase 7: README plus lessons capture
description: Per [[musicxml-support]] Phase 7: document the MusicXML input path (note: SongConverter currently has no README, so decide where format support is stated). File a docs/lessons entry for any non-obvious Phase 1/5 gotcha and check for stale README claims in the same pass.

title: MusicXML Phase 6: tests plus hand-authored .musicxml fixture
description: Per [[musicxml-support]] Phase 6: exercise shared convertScore note-mapping via alphaTex (no fixtures needed there); add one small hand-authored .musicxml fixture (few notes, not a real song, per repo no-real-song-files pattern) covering the MusicXMLImporter XML-to-Score step.

title: MusicXML Phase 5: handle unpopulated techniques, surface limitations
description: Per [[musicxml-support]] Phase 5: palm-mute needs no code (verify via Phase 1); add the cheap dead-note workaround (X notehead style to FretHandMute) in buildNote. Document slap/pop/harmonic-type as known v1 limitations surfaced in the status line (mirror skipped-track reporting) instead of speculative per-tool fallbacks.

title: MusicXML Phase 4: wire MusicXML UI tab
description: Per [[musicxml-support]] Phase 4: add MusicXML tab in main.ts mirroring the GP tab (accept=.musicxml,.xml,.mxl; same loadScoreFromBytes path, .mxl content-sniffed). Confirm GP error UX is informative enough and test the arbitrary-.xml AlphaTex-fallback behavior for clean errors.

title: MusicXML Phase 3: decide piano/vocals scope
description: Per [[musicxml-support]] Phase 3: decide whether a piano MusicXML path (grand-staff hand split, pedal marks, 8-level dynamics, GM-program detection reuse) is in v1 scope. Separately: include the small vocals path (beat.lyrics to SongVocal via generic part-json mechanism) regardless, and decide multi-part lyric source.

title: MusicXML Phase 2: generalize conversion core, fix hammer-on/pull-off
description: Per [[musicxml-support]] Phase 2: add convertMusicXml entry via ScoreLoader.loadScoreFromBytes, settle GpConvertResult naming, handle identically-named parts. Fix the confirmed stale noteStringLookup ordering bug (patch-package two-line re-index in string handler, verify vs project tests) and file the upstream alphaTab issue. Decide patch-vs-workaround per repo upstream-bug pattern.

title: MusicXML Phase 1: survey real-tool exports (tuning, P.M. variants)
description: Per [[musicxml-support]] Phase 1: verify whether real exports (MuseScore, Guitar Pro Export-to-MusicXML, TuxGuitar, Sibelius/Finale/Dorico) emit <staff-tuning>/TAB clef, and which exact <words> strings they use for palm-mute lines (alphaTab matches literal P.M.). W3C suite files already prove the importer handles present data; this closes the remains-open tool-emission gap.
close_reason: Survey complete: MuseScore + TuxGuitar verified at exporter source; findings in planning doc. GP/Sibelius/Finale/Dorico left as documented follow-ups.

comments.author: Andrew Gwinner
comments.text: Survey complete, findings recorded in [[musicxml-support]] Phase 1 follow-up (2026-10-01). MuseScore: tab staff emits staff-tuning + TAB clef; P.M. default text matches alphaTab literal via words+dashes path. TuxGuitar: per-string staff-tuning + TAB clef on staff 2; palm mute works via play/mute formal path (bare words ignored). GP export + Sibelius/Finale/Dorico unverified; GP needs one manual export test.
